ein klípa af þolinmæði á meðan tengiskriftin er lesin
steps: Deildu skjáskoti, límdu hlekk eða smelltu mynd af spjaldinu hennar ömmu.
Gervigreindin breytir því í almennilega uppskrift — hráefni, skref og tíma — og sýnir þér útkomuna til yfirferðar áður en hún er vistuð.
Raðaðu henni í bókina þína. Hún býr í símanum þínum; flyttu hana út sem PDF eða skjal hvenær sem er.

seo.title: Privacy — MyReciBook
seo.description: Your recipes live on your phone, not with us. What stays local, what the AI rescue sends and why, and what MyReciBook never does.

privacy.stamp: And it's as simple as that
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.meta: The short version: your recipes live on your phone, not with us.
privacy.localBody: Your cookbook — recipes, photos, pantry, food diary, tags — is plain files in a folder you choose on your device. We have no server that stores them, no account that holds them. Delete the app and the files are still yours.
privacy.leavesTitle: What leaves your phone, and why

leaves.rescues: AI rescues. When you import a screenshot, link or photo, its content is sent to our extraction service, which passes it to Google's Gemini model to be structured into a recipe, and hands the result back. It is used to answer that one request. We do not keep it.
leaves.counter: The rescue counter. To count AI rescues against your included 1,200 we key the tally to a one-way hash of your Play purchase token. We cannot read your identity out of it.
leaves.barcodes: Barcodes. Scanning a package queries the Open Food Facts database for that barcode.
leaves.crash: Crash reports. On by default so we can fix what breaks. Before anything is sent we strip out API keys, tokens, file names and folder paths — an error message can still carry a fragment of the text that broke, which is what makes it fixable. You can turn it off in Settings.
leaves.cloud: Your own cloud, if you connect it. Backup and export to Google Drive or Dropbox go to your account, under your control. We never see those files.

never.accounts: No accounts, no sign-up, no email collection.
never.ads: No ads, no selling or sharing data with data brokers.
never.storing: No storing your recipes on our servers.

privacy.websiteBody: This website is separate from the app. It counts nothing unless you say yes. If you do, Google Analytics sets a cookie and reports which pages you opened, roughly which country you are in, and what device you used. Nothing else. It never sees your name or email, and it never touches your recipes.

websiteStatus.granted: Right now: your visits are being counted.
websiteStatus.denied: Right now: your visits are not being counted.
websiteStatus.none: You have not answered yet, so nothing is being counted.

privacy.payBody: Purchases run through Google Play. We receive the purchase token to unlock the app and meter the AI cap — Google handles the payment details, we never see them.

seo.title: Terms — MyReciBook
seo.description: The deal in plain language: buy MyReciBook once, own it. What the included AI recipe rescues cover.

terms.title: Terms
terms.dealBody: You buy MyReciBook once on Google Play and it is yours: the cookbook, grocery list, pantry, barcode scanner, nutrition tracker, data export and cloud backup — no subscription and no account and future updates are free.
terms.rescuesBody: An AI recipe rescue turns a screenshot, a link or a photo into a structured recipe. Your purchase includes 1,200 of them. They do not expire and nothing resets — when they run out you can top up another 600 for $5, or plug in your own Google Gemini API key and run the AI directly at your own cost. Typing recipes in yourself is always unlimited and never counted. The count exists so one purchase can pay for its own AI bill; an "unlimited" AI is not something anyone can promise honestly, but I will strive to offer the lowest and efficient cost to Users with best results.
terms.contentBody: Recipes you import or write are yours to collect, hoard and back up. None of them is gatekept, landlorded or locked behind secret costs or clouds — the data is yours, fully and truly. Respect the rights of recipe authors when you share exports; MyReciBook is a filing box, not a publisher.
terms.takedownBody: If you believe anything published on this site or in our store listing uses material you own or have trademarked, write to {email}. Tell us what it is and where, and we will review it and take it down promptly.
terms.imperfectBody: The AI reads carefully, but not perfectly — you review every rescue before it is saved, and keeping your own collection tidy and backed up is your call. The app is provided as-is, and crash reports are what help us fix what breaks.
terms.personBody: There is a real person behind it, though. If something breaks, if you land in an odd corner, or if you want something the app does not do yet — write. Requests, suggestions and special cases are all welcome, and customers get an answer.
